standards.description: The faster an object moves, the more kinetic energy it has, and the more work it can do than at a slower speed.
standards.traceDetail: Moving cart holds kinetic energy that rises with its speed.

standards.description: Construct and interpret graphical displays of data to describe the relationships of kinetic energy to the mass of an object and to the speed of an object.
standards.traceDetail: Scale model of mass and speed sliders mapping to kinetic energy bar; KE = ½mv² with squared-speed emphasis.

standards.description: Write and evaluate numerical expressions involving whole-number exponents.
standards.traceDetail: Speed² in the KE example forms exponent-based evaluation.
